name: Kitazono Saya
source: The granddaughter of a famous politician and [url=/c40828]Shuuji's[/url] upperclassman... despite her baby face, short stature and humble chest. She has a tendency to get lost, to the point that there are intercom announcements asking people to help her. She loves teasing others and calls herself the older sister of the younger students.
